scripts.install: npm install express express-handlebars jquery serve-index morgan glob minimist bootstrap node-windows
scripts.uninstall: npm uninstall express express-handlebars jquery serve-index morgan glob minimist bootstrap node-windows
scripts.clean: npm run uninstall & RMDIR /S /Q node_modules >NUL 2>NUL & DEL /F /Q package-lock.json
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean & npm run install
